map.胎儿心率（CTG）基线变异 使用指南: Fetal Heart Rate (CTG) Baseline Variability User Guide
map.依据 FIGO（2015）/NICE（2017）标准，评估胎心基线、变异、加速与: Based on FIGO (2015)/NICE (2017) criteria, it assesses the fetal heart rate baseline, variability, accelerations and decelerations, and gives a CTG classification with management recommendations.
map.基线 110–160 bpm 正常；变异 5–25 bpm 正常；加速 ≥ 2/: Baseline 110-160 bpm normal; variability 5-25 bpm normal; accelerations >= 2 per 20 min normal
map.晚期/延长/正弦减速为病理性；可疑 1 项或病理性 ≥ 1 项 → 可疑/病理性: Late/prolonged/sinusoidal decelerations are pathological; 1 suspicious item or >= 1 pathological item means a suspicious/pathological CTG.
map.填写「20 分钟内加速次数」。: Enter the 'number of accelerations within 20 minutes'.
map.产时/远程胎心监护看基线心率是否正常。: During labour or remote fetal monitoring, check whether the baseline heart rate is normal.
map.结合变异与加速综合判断。: Judge comprehensively together with variability and accelerations.
map.：胎心基线 140 次/分（正常 110–160），变异中等、有加速，判为正常: : Fetal heart rate baseline 140 beats/min (normal 110-160) with moderate variability and accelerations present, classified as a normal CTG.
map.：基线 175 次/分（>160），持续 >10 分钟为胎儿心动过速，需排查母体: : Baseline 175 beats/min (>160) lasting more than 10 minutes is fetal tachycardia, requiring checks for maternal fever, infection or fetal hypoxia.
map.正常胎心基线范围？: What is the normal fetal heart rate baseline range?
map.110–160 次/分；<110 为心动过缓、>160 为心动过速，持续 10: 110-160 beats/min; <110 is bradycardia, >160 is tachycardia, and anything lasting more than 10 minutes is clinically significant.
map.母体发热、用药（如宫缩抑制剂）、胎儿睡眠-觉醒周期、缺氧等均可改变基线，需结合变: Maternal fever, medication (such as tocolytics), the fetal sleep-wake cycle and hypoxia can all change the baseline, so it must be interpreted together with variability and decelerations.
